import pytest
from subject import validate_import_path_format


def test_empty_string():
    assert validate_import_path_format("") == (False, "Import path cannot be empty")


def test_whitespace_only():
    assert validate_import_path_format("   ") == (False, "Import path cannot be empty")


def test_dangerous_characters():
    dangerous = "<>|&;`$'\"*?[]"
    for ch in dangerous:
        path = f"mod{ch}ule.Class"
        valid, msg = validate_import_path_format(path)
        assert valid is False
        assert "invalid characters" in msg
        assert ch in msg


def test_path_separators_and_double_dot():
    for bad in ["..", "/", "\\"]:
        path = f"mod{bad}ule.Class"
        valid, msg = validate_import_path_format(path)
        assert valid is False
        assert "path separators or '..'" in msg


def test_minimum_segment_count_one_segment():
    valid, msg = validate_import_path_format("SingleSegment")
    assert valid is False
    assert "at least 2 segments" in msg


def test_minimum_segment_count_two_segments_valid():
    valid, msg = validate_import_path_format("module.Class")
    assert valid is True
    assert msg is None


def test_empty_segment():
    for path in ["module..Class", ".module.Class", "module.Class.", "module.."]:
        valid, msg = validate_import_path_format(path)
        assert valid is False
        assert "empty segment" in msg


def test_invalid_identifier_segment():
    invalid_cases = [
        "1module.Class",      # starts with digit
        "module.1Class",      # segment starts with digit
        "module.Class-Name",  # hyphen
        "module.Class Name",  # space
        "module.Class@",      # special char
    ]
    for path in invalid_cases:
        valid, msg = validate_import_path_format(path)
        assert valid is False
        assert "not a valid Python identifier" in msg


def test_keyword_segment():
    keywords = ["class", "def", "for", "if", "else", "import", "from", "as", "with", "lambda"]
    for kw in keywords:
        path = f"module.{kw}"
        valid, msg = validate_import_path_format(path)
        assert valid is False
        assert "reserved keyword" in msg
        assert kw in msg


def test_valid_import_paths():
    valid_paths = [
        "package.module.Class",
        "a.b",
        "my_package.my_module.MyClass",
        "_private._internal._Class",
        "mod1.mod2.mod3.ClassName",
    ]
    for path in valid_paths:
        valid, msg = validate_import_path_format(path)
        assert valid is True, f"Expected valid for {path}, got {msg}"
        assert msg is None
